description: This PHP source file defines a utility class 'Sanitizer' within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides a method to sanitize SVG content using an external SVG sanitizer library, and throws a custom exception if sanitization fails.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: Provides functionality to sanitize SVG content strings, protecting against malicious SVG code.

methods.name: sanitizeSvg
methods.description: Sanitizes the given SVG content string using an external sanitizer. Throws an exception if the SVG is badly formatted.
